technologies.name: Live Wire Technology
technologies.description: Changes the molecular structure of the string to improve elasticity, resilience, power, comfort and control.

description.en: Gamma Live Wire is a premium multifilament tennis string engineered with Live Wire Technology to maximize elasticity and resilience. It delivers exceptional comfort, power, touch and arm-friendly performance while maintaining excellent control.
description.zh: Gamma Live Wire 是一款高端多芯结构球线，采用 Live Wire Technology 提升分子弹性与回复性能，提供极佳的舒适性、力量、手感及控球能力，同时对手臂更加友好。
